name: Borough of Broxbourne Local Plan Second Review 2001-2011

housing-numbers.notes: Structure Plan requirement 5,400 dwellings 1991-2011. As at March 2005, 4,848 completions achieved. Housing supply includes allocated sites from policies H4-H5, windfall allowance of 40 dwellings per annum for 2001-2011 period (400 total), and committed sites with permissions/s106 agreements. Total housing supply 6,696 dwellings exceeds requirement.
